decisions.reason: The modular plant concept is reported as saving customers more than 600,000 euros a year, it fits the firm's announced modular direction, and it carries substantial investment and public commitment, so management will persist with it.
The slow-speed shredder is a core product close to the established offer and has its own web page, which signals visible commitment and low risk, so dropping it is unlikely.

As a multi-model flagship line central to the firm's announced modular, cleaner-technology direction, it has the highest sunk investment and public commitment, and any early weak results would be put down to temporary market ramp-up.
The trommel screen is close to the firm's established offer and complements its shredders in mobile processing chains, and the firm is growing, so there is no reason to withdraw it.
